Name: Slightly recolored mines
Author: ralmuce
Description:
I really like different mine level designs in Stardew Valley, but I always felt like some needed a sliiight color change to fit my tastes. Recently I had a free evening and some motivation, so I made this.
Most of the changes are minor, but they made my mining experience a little better, so I thought I could share.

[b][size=3]To Install:[/size][/b]
Unzip and drop in your mods folder. If you want some changes, but not the others, I made a config for all of them - I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for changing it in-game.

[b][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
Compatible with anything except mine retextures. Keep in mind that there are other locations that use mine tilesheets, so things like farm caves may also be affected.

[b][size=3]Mods in screenshots:[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21351]Vanilla Tweaks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32218]Visual enemy variety[/url]﻿. My test farmer is wearing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4154]Sailor Moon clothes[/url]
